move.subject: Part 340010 – firm 24-month commitment for full allocation
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We understand capacity is tight and that you prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments. We would like to offer exactly that.

Our proposal: EUR 29.89/unit, 23,400 pcs/year, binding for both years of a 24-month contract. We would keep your quoted 54-day lead time, with payment 30 days, DAP, effective 2027-01-01. In exchange, we ask for full allocation at this price.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.
Your supplier-wide rolling on-time delivery was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3).
Our September forecast records a 10.1% change (fc:340010@2026-09).

These points are why we want a dependable full allocation backed by a binding commitment, which should benefit both sides.

Could you support this complete package?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. We acknowledge your proposal for a 24-month contract at 23,400 units per year. We can offer EUR 31.70 per unit for this package. The terms of our offer are a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days. Which volume can you commit to? This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Seal 24 mm – complete package for full allocation
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation, for checking our figures, and for moving to our full volume.

To answer your question: we can commit to 23,400 pcs/year, binding for every contract year.

To meet you, we are improving our proposal on two points at once. We raise our price from EUR 29.89 to EUR 31.00/unit, and we add a third binding year, making it a 36-month contract. We would keep your quoted 54-day lead time, with payment 30 days, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling.

In return, we ask for dependable full allocation of 23,400 pcs/year over all three years.

If you can accept this complete package, we would conclude on it.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your proposal for a 36-month contract at 23,400 units per year. 

We can offer EUR 31.40 per unit for this 36-month package. For this volume of 23400 pcs per year, our terms remain a price of €31.40 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 54 days, and a contract term of 36 months. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer remains valid for 7 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
